Design journey

Every design exploration from 21 to 24 October 2026, in the order we made them, with what each one taught us. Each is embedded in full and still works: open it to tap around. The current designs live in their own files: the app pages and the collections brainstorm.

  • MaterialNavy paper sheet → Liquid Glass over black
  • TypeGeist → IBM Plex Sans and Mono
  • LayoutFive concepts → one song on phones, two side by side on wide screens, Present for the TV
  • ControlsPanels of settings → live trays, with set-once choices in Settings
  • ScopeOne shared-link reader → the whole app around it
    Today · 24 Oct

    Where it is now

    • App pages: Home, Songs, Setlists, Folders, the song and setlist editors, Settings, Account and sign-in, with the reader built in, on a phone, an iPad and a desktop.
    • Collections brainstorm: where public song collections could live, the research behind them, and the guardrails that keep them from becoming social media.
